Overview

Gdańsk is a city in Pomeranian with a population of 486,022. The beautiful Baltic port city where Solidarity was born, featuring a stunning Gothic old town, amber beaches, and a rich maritime history. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
